 Follow Joy Behar Update: Co-Host Still Missing From 'The View'
 Anne Erickson Mon, October 26, 2026 at 8:53 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Lou Rocco/Getty Images If you've been watching The View and noticed that host Joy Behar has been missing for three weeks, it's not your TV playing tricks on you. The co-host and comedian, 84, is now in her third week of not being part of the show after an injury incident.
 On Tuesday, Oct. 20, moderator Whoopi Goldberg shared the news that Behar is still taking time off the show, even though last week, she hinted that Behar was expected to be back in her co-hosting chair.
 Behar suffered a shoulder injury while she was on set backstage, and she's dealing with a dislocated shoulder.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "So, Joy is still out healing up. I know, I know, she's still healing," Goldberg said on Tuesday's show, according to Entertainment Weekly . "But, she made a big deal calling people in the dead of night, saying, 'You make sure that you wish Sunny a happy birthday from me.'"

 The Sunny reference is because Tuesday was Sunny Hostin's birthday.
 "I miss Joy. We all do. We miss Joy so very much," Hostin added. "Joy, if you're watching, when you get your butt back, I expect a lasagna with a little candle in it."
 Advertisement Advertisement Goldberg chimed in again, stating, "We'll have something special when you know you're on your way back. Hurry back. It's not the same at the table. We miss you, we do."
 Not seeing Behar in her co-hosting chair is a big change for viewers. She began hosting The View back in August 1997, so she's been with it since the ABC daytime talk show first debuted. She's also the show's longest-serving panelist.
 Behar was an original co-host from the start of the show, and then she left the program in 2013. She came back, however, in September 2015 to once again serve as a permanent co-host.
